parsed.explanation: Evidence is strong and recent. The state has officially licensed religious departments to enforce against trans people (2020), and documented mobilisation of 122 officers to hunt a trans woman. Queer venues face raids, most recently a November 2025 sauna raid with 208 arrests, pre-tipped media, leaked identities and foreign nationals held. The national sodomy statute (20 years plus whipping) expressly applies to tourists, though enforcement against them is described as rare. Prison placement by birth sex with male-ward sexual violence is documented. There are no hate-crime or anti-discrimination protections and no recourse. Mitigating factors are thin: the cross-dressing offence reaches only Muslims, enforcement is episodic, the last documented trans killing is from 2019 with no trans-specific violence rate, and I found no visa rule for trans visitors. Residence-side gender-marker rules are not counted against visitors. Overall this is organised, state-directed targeting with severe penal exposure, placing it in the high-risk band, just above severe.
